title: Generative machine learning for protein design
abstract: arXiv:2603.26378v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Designing proteins with specific biological functions is of considerable interest for both the development of new therapeutics and the engineering of enzymes, yet achieving the intended activity remains challenging. Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a powerful tool to explore the vast space of possible designs by learning from protein sequence and structural data. Here, we review 59 generative approaches across six protein design tasks, including sequence generation, backbone generation, structure-conditioned sequence design, joint sequence-structure design, motif scaffolding, and binder and antibody design. We outline common generative approaches and protein representations and discuss how structural constraints and functional information are utilized during generation. translated_title: 蛋白质设计的生成式机器学习
translated_abstract: 设计具有特定生物功能的蛋白质对于新疗法的开发以及酶的工程化改造都具有重要意义，然而实现预期的蛋白质活性仍然充满挑战。生成式人工智能（AI）通过从蛋白质序列和结构数据中学习，已成为探索庞大可能设计空间的有力工具。本文综述了涵盖六种蛋白质设计任务的59种生成式方法，包括序列生成、骨架生成、结构条件下的序列设计、序列-结构联合设计、基序支架构建以及结合蛋白和抗体设计。我们概述了常见的生成方法和蛋白质表示形式，并讨论了在生成过程中如何利用结构约束和功能信息。随后，我们讨论了用于评估所设计蛋白质的计算与实验方法，以及这些评估……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文系统综述了59种生成式机器学习方法在六类蛋白质设计任务（序列生成、骨架生成、结构条件序列设计、序列-结构联合设计、基序支架及结合蛋白/抗体设计）中的应用，并讨论了设计蛋白质的计算与实验评估方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reviews 59 generative machine learning approaches across six protein design tasks—including sequence generation, backbone generation, structure-conditioned sequence design, joint sequence-structure design, motif scaffolding, and binder/antibody design—and discusses computational and experimental methods for evaluating designed proteins.
